```{r}
#| fig-asp: 1
#| out-width: "85%"
#| fig-width: 7.285714
# fetch pipeline output
mods <- tar_read(
  models_stab_across_habitats,
  store = here::here(Sys.getenv("PATH_BIRDPOPVAR"), "_targets")
)

# extract partial residuals for both responses
part_fit_sig <- c("sd_r_average", "abs_trend_average") %>% 
  set_names %>% 
  map(\(r) partials_fitted_and_signif(r, covariables = c("HII_focal", "H_fine", "mu_SR", "N_POINTS_avg"), mods = mods))

# list of panel titles
labs_response = list(
  sd_r_average = "Mean detrended population variability",
  abs_trend_average = "Mean absolute trend"
)

# run plot function on both responses
plotlist_partials <- part_fit_sig %>% 
  map2(., names(.), function(l, response) {
    plot_partials_and_fit(l$partials, l$fitted, l$signif, title = labs_response[[response]])
  })

# two-panel plot
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plotlist_partials, ncol = 2, labels = c("(a)", "(b)"))
```
